image.build_notes: 2026-09-09: real legacy Docker rebuild of the final Dockerfile adding the SHA256-pinned tblib 3.1.0 test dependency and upstream test collection as agent. Build cache was enabled; this is not a no-cache rebuild. Git history comes from the local git-daemon mirror; exact Base/tree and ancestry-only assertions remain in the Dockerfile and passed. The official runtime/native overlay and candidate source Base are unchanged. Full build log and actual image inspection are archived with this validation. Previous image/build evidence is retained in validation/history/pre-environment-fixture-repair-evidence.json.
image.image_check: build passed; independent image check recorded in validation/e2e-evidence.json

gates.verification: pass for recorded controls and alternatives

review.attribution: The revised Opus candidate has mapping, profiling and budget defects. Separately, the task image omitted tblib required by the normal upstream test entrypoint, and the statement needed to specify whole-item encoding budget for a partial prompt window.
review.decision: Add a SHA256-pinned tblib wheel to the normal image test dependencies; verify upstream collection during image build and run all nine cache-manager tests offline as agent. Clarify that scheduling an uncached item charges its complete encoder output even for a partial prompt subrange. Verifier, Oracle, scoring and interpreter behavior are unchanged.
review.boundary: Prompt windows and masked PlaceholderRange -> real request/cache manager/scheduler/registry profiler and model-runner gather/slice -> embedding-row allocations, budgets and selected embeddings. Synthetic multimodal inputs replace an encoder model; all accounting and mapping transitions execute production code on CPU.
review.coverage: Masked/mask-free/all-false/empty/multi-item placeholders; 100 positions and 8 embedding rows; partial prompt mapping and full-item budgets; profiling and gather/slice; independent mask-count implementation; budget omission and process/result controls.
